import re

# Test the pattern more carefully
pattern = r'([-+ ]?\d+|[-+ ]?0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+|[-+ ]?0[bB][01]+|[-+ ]?0[oO][0-7]+)(\w+)'

# First let's see what the first part matches
m1 = re.match(r'[-+ ]?\d+', '42 hello')
print(f'm1: {m1.group(0)!r}')

# Now the full pattern
m2 = re.match(pattern, '42 hello')
print(f'm2.group(0): {m2.group(0)!r}')
print(f'm2.groups(): {m2.groups()}')

# Let me try without alternation
m3 = re.match(r'(\d+)(\w+)', '42 hello')
print(f'm3.group(0): {m3.group(0)!r}')
print(f'm3.groups(): {m3.groups()}')
"
